desc: Parse T and each (R,B); check for the impossible case (R+B=1 equivalent) and output "No" when (R=0,B=1) or (R=1,B=0) or R is odd.
Case (R=0, B even ≥ 2): build diamond cycle using (2,2), (3,3), ..., (k+1,k+1), (k+2,k), (k+1,k-1), ..., (3,1) where B=2k.
Case (B=0, R even ≥ 2): build rectangle perimeter of 2×(R/2) grid.

Case (R≥2, B≥1): implement a correct unified construction for all valid (R, B) pairs. Use the R=2k, B=1 base (verified working) and extend by adding blue pieces via insertion into the row-3 segment: replace edge (3,c+1)R→(3,c)R with (3,c+1)R→(2,c+1)B→(3,c)R for c=1,...,k-2. This handles B ≤ k+1. For B > k+1, use a larger construction (e.g., extend the base with more rows or use a different staircase). Verify each transition.
Integrate the three constructions into the main loop, collecting output lines.
Ensure all coordinates are within 1..10^9 and output is flushed properly.
